title: Mechanical resonance fingerprint
note: When industrial sensor data fits a damped oscillator, the natural frequency reveals the structural mode and the damping ratio reveals how much energy is dissipated per cycle. Both shift over time as components wear: a drift in the fitted parameters is the leading indicator of bearing degradation, mounting drift, or imbalance.

title: Predictive maintenance window
note: Anomaly clustering in equipment data is the predictive-maintenance trigger condition. The window for cheap intervention is short — fault probability is rising, time-to-failure is finite. Schedule the maintenance now, not later.
